🧠 HYPEUSDT + XAUUSD SMC SETUPS — LIVE

HYPEUSDT
Current: ~$91.00

HTF READ
• Daily structure has recovered from the ~$84.64–$86.16 sell-side area and reclaimed $90.
• 4H is printing higher highs/higher lows from the ~$87.5–$88.0 base.
• 1H/15M remain bullish, but price is pressing the $91.00 liquidity/high.

🎯 PRIMARY LONG
Wait for a retrace into ~$90.45–$90.70, then require bullish 15M displacement/reclaim.

Targets:
→ $91.50
→ $92.50
→ $94.00–$94.50

Invalidation: sustained loss of ~$89.80. Stronger structural invalidation below ~$87.50.

🚀 BREAKOUT ALTERNATIVE
Clean 1H acceptance above $91.00 opens $91.50 → $92.50.

⚠️ HYPE verdict: BULLISH, but do not chase the current high. Retest is cleaner.

XAUUSD
Current spot: ~$4,140–$4,142. Gold is closed/illiquid for the weekend; this is a next-session map.

HTF READ
• Daily/4H structure remains bearish after rejection from ~$4,197–$4,225.
• Friday's move swept highs and displaced sharply lower toward ~$4,126.
• Price is now sitting near the lower end of the range, so chasing shorts here is poor R:R.
• Key bearish FVG/resistance sits around ~$4,158–$4,177.

🎯 PRIMARY SHORT
Wait for a retrace into ~$4,158–$4,177, then require bearish 15M displacement/rejection.

Targets:
→ $4,126
→ $4,115
→ $4,100

Invalidation: sustained acceptance above ~$4,197; stronger invalidation above ~$4,225.

🔴 BREAKDOWN ALTERNATIVE
If $4,126 breaks with bearish 15M displacement, continuation toward $4,115 → $4,100 becomes the cleaner momentum scenario.

⚠️ XAUUSD verdict: BEARISH, but currently extended at support. Prefer selling the retracement.
